content.title: The App Router and Project Structure
content.hook: A framework becomes useful when its structure carries meaning.
content.context:
In the Next.js App Router, folders and special files describe the application.

A simplified project can look like this:

```text
app/
  layout.tsx
  page.tsx
  dashboard/
    page.tsx
  settings/
    page.tsx
```

The important idea is not memorizing filenames.

The important idea is:

**The filesystem is part of the application's route structure.**
goals: Master The App Router and Project Structure: The filesystem is part of the application's route structure.

content.question:
Given:

```text
app/
  page.tsx
  dashboard/
    page.tsx
```

Which URL should the second page represent?

feedback.correct: The `app` directory is the route tree. A `page.tsx` inside `dashboard` creates the `/dashboard` route.
feedback.incorrect: The `app` directory is the route tree. A `page.tsx` inside `dashboard` creates the `/dashboard` route.

content.title: Root layout
content.text:
A root `layout.tsx` is shared across the application.

That makes it a natural place for application-wide structure such as the document shell.

The root layout is not the same thing as a random wrapper component. It participates in the framework's routing system.

content.title: Colocation
content.text:
Next.js also lets you keep route-related code close to the route.

That can mean:

```text
app/
  dashboard/
    page.tsx
    loading.tsx
    error.tsx
    components/
```

The benefit is cognitive locality.

When investigating `/dashboard`, you can stay near `/dashboard`.

activities.title: Build the map
activities.instruction: Compose your response below, then submit to compare with the reference guide.

content.prompt:
Given:

```text
app/
  page.tsx
  products/
    page.tsx
    [id]/
      page.tsx
```

Predict these routes:

1. `page.tsx` at the root
2. `products/page.tsx`
3. `products/[id]/page.tsx`
guidelines: State your reasoning clearly in your own words or code.
Compare your response with the reference guide after submitting.
content.sampleResponse:
1. `/`
2. `/products`
3. `/products/:id`

The third is a dynamic segment: one route shape can represent different identifiers.

feedback.correct:
1. `/`
2. `/products`
3. `/products/:id`

The third is a dynamic segment: one route shape can represent different identifiers.
